Browser extra_wait adds additional time after network_idle to ensure all async operations complete

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"browser\":{\"extra_wait\":200,\"mode\":\"always\",\"wait\":\"network_idle\"}}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let _ = scrape(&engine, &url).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.browser_used);
}
```
